drought stress has a negative impact in lentil seed germination and seedling growth, and the effect is genotype-dependent.
drought stress affects germination and growth parameters in lentil genotypes and that genotypic differences exist in the response of genotypes to drought.
lentil genotypes vary in their ability to cope with water stress.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the response of various lentil genotypes under PEG induced drought stress and the effect of drought stress on seed germination potential, and seedling growth.
the development of a rapid and cost effective screening method for identifying drought tolerant germoplasm in lentil.
the identification of lentil genotypes with improved drought tolerance, which could be further utilized in breeding programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

drought tolerance in lentil is a complex trait, which is influenced by several physiological and morphological factors and that the identification of drought tolerant genotypes can be achieved through the use of appropriate selection criteria.
the use of PEG 6000 is a useful tool for the selection of drought tolerance in lentil genotypes at the seed stage.
lentil cultivar Elpida Samos and Thesalia are the most drought tolerant genotypes, whereas cultivar Flip 24L is the least drought tolerant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
drought tolerance can be identified at the seedling stage and that this trait is heritable.
lentil genotypes with high germination and seedling growth potential under drought stress are likely to perform better under field conditions.
the seed germination and seedling growth of lentil genotypes under PEG 6000 induced drought stress is a promising tool to identify drought tolerant lentil germplasm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
lentil genotypes with high germination and growth potential in water deficit environments are more likely to be drought tolerant.
the use of PEG induced drought stress can be an efficient tool to identify drought tolerance at early stages of lentil growth and development.
the seed germination and the early growth of seedlings can be used as a tool to identify drought tolerant germplasms at an early stage of plant development.
